revision: aa1ca3d + offload-budget and 16 MiB/s control experiments
notes: Normal release on aa1ca3d plus sender-offload-budget-experiment.patch and sender-ack-rate-diagnostic.patch. Offload floor is three send quanta; control limit is 16 MiB/s. DATA burst remains one quantum/64 datagrams and control burst remains 16 datagrams.
Ordinary release tests and all-target/all-feature musl Clippy pass. Full kernel and routed PMTU acceptance were not run for this combined policy experiment.

Unlimited point records 350 inner right-receiver UDP receive-buffer errors, also visible in SO_RXQ_OVFL. These count dropped SKBs, not exact inner frames. All other points have zero inner UDP errors. No point has outer fragmentation, outer socket overflow or receive errors, worker admission pressure, or receiver invalid/duplicate/out-of-window/wrong-run/reordered records.

Unlimited goodput falls 6.5% forward and 8.8% reverse from the paced 21 Gbit/s point. The reverse receiver has zero inner UDP errors. The causes of this decline are unresolved; repeat and attribution are required before adoption.
Four 20-second retained-daemon points; no builds or other tests overlap load. Experimental policy, not adopted.

Directions L->R/R->L, endpoint arrays L/R; goodput excludes drain, missing ratios include drain. 100% CPU equals one core. TAP SKB drops, frame expiry and queue entries cannot be summed into exact frame loss.
